name: Opsgenie Cloud
description: Opsgenie is Atlassian's legacy alerting and on-call platform for consolidating operational alerts and notifying responders.
agentUseSummary: Connect an existing read-enabled Opsgenie API key and region, then let agents list bounded alert summaries or inspect one exact alert without mutations or account configuration.

credentialRequirements.name: OPSGENIE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Opsgenie API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a read-enabled account API key from an existing Opsgenie account.

credentialRequirements.name: OPSGENIE_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Opsgenie region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter US or EU so Relay uses only the matching official Opsgenie origin.

capabilities.label: Read alerts
capabilities.description: List bounded alert summaries and inspect one exact alert without mutations or configuration access.

allowed.label: List alerts
allowed.description: List at most 25 bounded alert summaries for one exact US or EU Opsgenie account.

allowed.label: Read one alert
allowed.description: Read a bounded summary for one exact Opsgenie alert ID.

blocked.label: Change alerts
blocked.description: Creating, acknowledging, closing, deleting, or otherwise changing alerts is unavailable in this read-only legacy connector.

blocked.label: Manage Opsgenie
blocked.description: Users, teams, schedules, integrations, policies, services, and account configuration are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Read only
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded alert reads run directly; every mutation and configuration action remains blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts two read-only alert wrappers and keeps the API key server-side.
Railway mounts two read-only alert wrappers and keeps the API key server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Opsgenie is closed to new sales and reaches end of support on 5 April 2027; this connector is only for existing customers while the API remains supported.
providerSetup.nextAction: An existing customer enters a read-enabled account API key and its US or EU region. New customers should use Jira Service Management or Compass instead.

evidence.supports: Opsgenie documents its still-operational REST API, separate US and EU origins, and the migration notice for end of support.
The official Alert API documents GenieKey authorization, List Alerts, Get Alert, result bounds, filters, and alert lifecycle operations.
Atlassian documents read-enabled account API keys and explicitly permits Get Alert and List Alerts while distinguishing mutation-restricted account keys from integration keys.
Atlassian states that new Opsgenie sales ended 4 June 2025 and support ends 5 April 2027, with migration to Jira Service Management or Compass.
